name: omni-mcp-manager
stderr:
Usage: omni-mcp [options] [command]

One proxy. All your MCP servers. Every IDE.

Options:
  -V, --version                   output the version number
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]                 Start the proxy gateway (runs in background by
                                  default)
  stop [options]                  Graceful shutdown of running instance
  status [options]                Show current state of running instance
  validate [options]              Validate config without starting
  reload [options]                Hot-reload configuration
  restart [options]               Stop the running instance and start it again
                                  in the background
  add [options] <server-name>     Add a server to config
  remove [options] <server-name>  Remove a server from config
  ide-snippets [options]          Print IDE configuration snippets
  init [options]                  Interactive setup with auto-import
  secrets                         Manage write-only variables and secret
                                  backends
  server                          Manage MCP servers
  profile                         Manage tool-access profiles
  token                           Manage token-to-profile mappings
  config                          Inspect or replace configuration
  logs                            Inspect metadata-only traffic logs
  tools                           Direct playground access to configured servers
  cli                             Discover and call tools from CLI-enabled
                                  managed MCP servers
  help [command]                  display help for command
